description: EDLI Scheme 2026 made under s.6C of the EPF & MP Act 1952. NOTE THE FIXTURE ID IS A MISNOMER RETAINED FOR STABILITY: the rate is UNVERIFIED, not unnotified. An earlier version of this description asserted as a FACT that the 2026 contribution rate was 'to be notified separately' and had not been notified. That claim has been RETRACTED — a contribution rate of 0.50% of EDLI wages with effect from 29 June 2026 is REPORTED by legal-press accounts of the Ministry's notification of 1 July 2026, SECONDARY SOURCES ONLY, and no primary G.S.R. text could be read from this environment. The rate row therefore stays ConfUnverified and the component stays DEFERRED, which is the safe direction, but a real employer liability of roughly Rs 75 per member per month is accruing unbooked and the G.S.R. must be read before real books. The two ADMINISTRATIVE CHARGES are a different case and are genuinely unknown: no 2026-Scheme rate of any kind could be found for either. Hand derivation: EDLI WAGES are pure arithmetic and ARE derived — min(statutory wage 15000.0000, EDLI ceiling 15000.0000) = 15000.0000 — but the CONTRIBUTION is not, so the engine emits named deferrals for EDLI_CONTRIBUTION, EDLI_ADMIN_CHARGES and EPF_ADMIN_CHARGES and produces no component row for any of them. Applying the superseded 1976 Scheme's 0.50% would have produced 75.0000, a confidently wrong number that reconciles against nothing and that an employer would remit. Every other figure matches pf-at-ceiling-statutory-only: 1800, 1250 and 550.
